instruction: Turn on the battery percentage indicator in the system tray.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling battery percentage display by setting show-battery-percentage to true. The evaluator verifies the gsettings value is 'true'. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the battery percentage setting state using gsettings command
Metric performs exact string comparison which is appropriate for gsettings boolean output
Expected value 'true\n' correctly matches the gsettings command output format (includes newline)
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (battery percentage enabled)
Data flow is correct: vm_command_line executes gsettings get -> returns stdout -> exact_match compares with expected value
No postconfig needed: gsettings values persist after agent actions complete
Edge cases handled: returns 1.0 if enabled, 0.0 if disabled or command fails
